workshopsData.title: The Ultimate RC Plane Workshop
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × AeroCET presents The Ultimate RC Plane Workshop. Explore the fundamentals of aerodynamics, aircraft design and flight control as you configure your very own RC aircraft and put it to the test. 📅 September 18, 19 and 20. Let your vision soar the skies ✨ Your vision. Your Drishti.
details: Workshop Focus : Aerodynamics · Aircraft Design · Flight Control.
Experience : Configure your own RC aircraft and put it to the test.
Passes : 1 Day Workshop Pass · 3 Day Workshop Pass.

workshopsData.title: SolidWorks Online Workshop
workshopsData.description: From Vision to dimension. Drishti’26 × Herakles brings you SolidWorks Online Workshop 🚀 The one session your ideas need to take shape! Your vision. Your Drishti.

workshopsData.title: MATLAB Workshop
workshopsData.description: Code your concepts into Vision. Join Drishti’26 × Herakles for the MATLAB Workshop and explore MATLAB from the fundamentals of coding to practical applications.

workshopsData.title: ANSYS Online Workshop
workshopsData.description: Analyze beyond the blueprint. Drishti’26 × Herakles brings you ANSYS Online Workshop. Turn engineering ideas into something you can test, analyse and perfect. Your vision. Your Drishti.

workshopsData.title: Unreal Engine Workshop
workshopsData.description: Join Drishti’26 × Glitch CET for Unreal Engine: Introduction to Game Development. A hands-on, 6-hour beginner workshop led by Muhammed Faizal PK, founder, Custodian Games.
details: Bring your laptop (with UE 5.6 pre-installed) and a mouse!

workshopsData.title: Privatisation of Space Industry
workshopsData.description: Join industry experts and space-sector pioneers as they delve into the opportunities, challenges, and future of India’s rapidly evolving private space industry.

workshopsData.title: PCB Design Workshop
workshopsData.description: Homegrown talent leading the hardware revolution. Two of our very own CET alumnae are returning to campus as industry powerhouses to show you how real-world boards are engineered. Organized by Drishti’26 × IET

workshopsData.title: Beyond Progress: Humanity's future in a changing cosmos
workshopsData.description: Join us for an insightful conversation on humanity, science, progress, and our place in a rapidly changing cosmos featuring Jithinraj R S (Founder, JR Studio | Journalist | Science Communicator).

workshopsData.title: DECODING AI
workshopsData.description:
AI is everywhere, but what is really going on behind the hood?
It’s time to look beyond the prompts and understand what makes AI tick.
details: Speaker: Dr. Deepak Mishra - IIST, Thiruvananthapuram

workshopsData.title: WHEN LIGHT GOES QUANTUM : PHOTONS & TECHNOLOGY
workshopsData.description:
What if the smallest particles could power the biggest breakthroughs? 
Step into the world of quantum computing and technology.
details: Speaker: Dr. Ashok Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Physics, IIST.

workshopsData.title: VERILOG AND FPGA
workshopsData.description: What if the logic you write could actually come alive on a chip? Step into the world of VLSI and digital design, get started with Verilog HDL, and explore hands-on FPGA implementation using Xilinx Vivado — where theory meets real-world chip design. Organized by Drishti'26 × RoboCET

workshopsData.title: ETABS
workshopsData.description: Every strong structure starts as numbers on a screen. ETABS is where engineers turn sketches into certainty. Come learn how the strongest buildings actually get made with Drishti'26 x ICI CET

workshopsData.title: Race Car Dynamics
workshopsData.description: Speed has its own language. Force. Motion. Control. Learn how calculations, control, and engineering come together in Race Car Dynamics with Drishti'26 x Zenith.

workshopsData.title: Arduino
workshopsData.description: From code to circuits, turn your ideas into something you can actually build. Get hands-on with Arduino, explore the world of electronics, and bring your own ideas to life with Drishti'26 x Herakles.

workshopsData.title: Nix & NixOS
workshopsData.description: Shift from fragile setups to immutable perfection. Join Vysakh Premkumar to unlock pure declarative power and eliminate 'works on my machine' forever with Drishti'26 x FOSS CET.

workshopsData.title: TinyML: From Zero to Edge Intelligence
workshopsData.alt: TinyML: From Zero to Edge Intelligence workshop
workshopsData.description: Discover how intelligence moves from the cloud to the edge, giving tiny devices a brain of their own. Join Abhinav Krishna N, Ranger Seeed Studio, for a workshop on TinyML and edge intelligence with Drishti'26 × IEEE SB CET.
